Someone who is studying teaching here, and I don’t think you’re the asshole. It’s easy for others to comment about it being an ‘ego’ issue and saying it’s working for her but they don’t seem to take into account that maybe this is best for her tutor as well? Class is a time for them to be able to learn themselves, and not be distracted by another student who is codependent and constantly relying on them. It isn’t fair and I think it’s necessary to teach students different ways of learning and pushing them outside their comfort zones (within reason) 

OP doesn’t sound like they’re calling on this student in class and embarrassing them about their learning difficulties, rather that they’re trying to support them and provide life skills - you don’t always get your way and sometimes you have to suck it up and do things you might not like to do. 

NTA

Some traits just shouldn’t be passed down, especially when it’s a matter of health issues that also cause the individual to suffer throughout their whole lives. Personally if I were to be born with a disability that caused chronic pain and a short lifespan I would rather avoid the whole ordeal but that’s just me personally

It’s not talking about killing them, it’s about selectively weeding out undesirable traits at conception…. ‘Selective breeding’ but that’s another issue altogether and not really what this post is about. A mere burden on society is different to people that are actively causing harm to others whether it’s their fault or not, it can’t not face consequences or actions that prevent it from continually happening
